citation: "Second Presbyterian Church, Open Today" [halftone of the reconstructed church, with caption]. Chicago Sunday Tribune, 10 November 1901 (vol. 60 no. 313).
author: Chicago Sunday Tribune
describes_date: 1901-11 (the church as rededicated after the fire of March 1900)
locator: Page index 7; the Prairie library's crop nps-2ndpres-tribune-1901-11-10-open-today-cut (874 x 1400 px).
note: The caption: 'While it is called a reconstructed building, the structure partially is new. Only the walls and the tower remained after the fire a year and a half ago.' The cut, from the south-east across Michigan Avenue at 20th Street, shows the tower at the south-east corner with its full spire, the east front's gable with its great window and the north corner's pinnacle, the south flank under a roof with dormers, and a gabled hall at the west end on 20th Street.
